lines.text: The siren just started its four-minute cycle, and the fog is crawling beneath your door.
You have thirty seconds to run into one of four emergency shelters.
Shelter one is an abandoned subway terminal with heavy steel gates.
The gate locks from inside, but footsteps keep pacing on the dark rails right below.
Shelter two is an empty hotel room on the fifth floor.
The television only displays static, and the bathroom mirror reflects a room that is not yours.
Shelter three is an underground boiler bunker with heavy steam pipes.
Nothing can break in, but the room temperature climbs by five degrees every ten minutes.
Shelter four is a boarded roadside diner with a rotary phone on the counter.
The phone rings once every hour, whispering your childhood secrets. Which door do you lock?
